sources.title: OpenAlex scholarly metadata
sources.rights_review: OpenAlex metadata may be acquired as metadata. Linked full text retains its own rights and is not automatically acquired.
sources.acquisition_method: OpenAlex Works API through the governed data-acquisition worker
sources.notes: Use API keys and polite-pool identification where configured. Store provenance and retrieval time.

sources.title: Crossref scholarly metadata
sources.rights_review: Acquire bibliographic metadata only. Licence fields supplied by members apply to linked content and must be evaluated independently.
sources.acquisition_method: Crossref REST API through the governed data-acquisition worker
sources.notes: Metadata retrieval does not grant rights to publisher full text.

sources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare
sources.rights_review: Do not place course content in the commercial production corpus without a separate permission review. Metadata and links may be catalogued.
sources.notes: Suitable for noncommercial research evaluation subject to attribution and share-alike obligations.

sources.title: OpenStax textbooks and teaching resources
sources.rights_review: Review the exact textbook and current terms before acquisition. Licences and AI-related restrictions may differ by title and edition.
sources.acquisition_method: Manual title-level approval with checksum and licence snapshot
sources.notes: No OpenStax full text is bundled in this repository.

sources.title: OER Commons
sources.rights_review: OER Commons aggregates resources with item-specific licences. Every item requires its own rights and provenance review.
sources.acquisition_method: Manual item-level registration; do not scrape or bulk acquire without permission
sources.notes: Catalogue links and metadata first; acquire content only after item-level approval.

sources.title: MERLOT teaching and learning materials
sources.rights_review: Materials and linked resources have item-specific terms. Do not ingest content without a recorded rights decision.
sources.notes: Use as a discovery source, not an assumed training corpus.
